GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (30 Nov 45) CCS
(SCAPIN - 373)
APO 500
30 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Generator of Navy Transmission Station in Oshima.
1. Reference is made to letter CLO No. 650 (4.2) Imperial Japanese Government, subject, Generator of Navy Transmission Station in Oshima, dated 20 November 1945.
2. The Japanese Government will be permitted to run lines into the generator and take off power not to exceed fifty (50) kilowatts on condition that:
a. Load can be regulated as not to impair operation of occupation force radio range equipment by reason of sudden substantial changes in generator output voltages.
b. The arrangement be discontinued, or the load and method of regulating same be modified, if necessary to permit satisfactory operation of occupation force radio range equipment.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
